subject: Free module context even if there was no content written in auxsave2 (#2132)
reason: The change only frees a lazily-allocated ValkeyModuleCtx on the early-return path of rdbSaveSingleModuleAux when a module's aux_save2 callback wrote nothing — a pure memory-leak fix with no observable behaviour change (no reply, RDB content, replication or persistence difference). Triggering even the leak requires a loaded module whose aux_save2 writes no data yet calls ValkeyModule_GetContextFromIO to allocate io.ctx; no in-tree module does this (testrdb's test2rdb_aux_save never obtains a context, leaving io.ctx NULL), and fuzzer experiments cannot load modules: MODULE LOAD is refused in com
